files.BRIEF.md:

Plan how reads remain coherent after writes across two service instances. Preserve the public API. Do not implement.
files.docs/product.md:
# Product

A configuration service where correctness is more important than stale-read latency.
files.docs/capabilities.md:
# Capabilities

## CAP-001 — coherent reads

Reads must not return a value older than the most recently acknowledged write.

files.BRIEF.md:
# Audit events

Design durable audit-event storage. Requirements: ordered per account, queryable for 90 days, recoverable after partial failure. No architecture is prescribed.
files.docs/architecture.md:
# Architecture

The service currently uses a relational primary store and an asynchronous worker boundary.

status: accepted

files.docs/capabilities.md:

## CAP-001 — persistence

Configuration is stored transactionally.
files.docs/architecture.md:
# Architecture

The service boundary owns persistence; callers never access storage directly.
files.docs/decisions/ADR-0002-old.md:
# ADR-0002
status: superseded
superseded_by: ADR-0003

Callers may access storage.
files.docs/decisions/ADR-0003-current.md:
# ADR-0003
status: accepted

The service exclusively owns storage to preserve authorization and migrations.
